info.description: Close-Quarters Archery feat — ATÉRIOR custom General feat.
info.author: Falling-Cats

description.p: You've learned to fight in the collapsed halls and buried ruins that riddle Atérior, where the difference between a killing shot and a dead adventurer is measured in feet, not yards. You gain the following benefits.
Firing in Melee. Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn't impose Disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.
Bypass Cover. Your ranged attacks ignore Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover against targets within 30 feet of you.
Trained Aim. You gain a +1 bonus to ranged attack rolls.

sheet.description: No Disadvantage on ranged attacks within 5 ft. of a hostile creature. Ignore Half/Three-Quarters Cover within 30 ft. +1 to ranged attack rolls.
